title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Dream 1659 views Q. A few years back I had the privilege of attending a few lectures of Hazrat Moulana Anzar Shah Saheb (DB) in my local masjid. Since then, I have had a few dreams about him and would like to know their meanings. 1. I had a dream that Moulana Saheb (DB) was very weak and was about to break into pieces inside my local masjid and I was carrying him and trying to get help for him. Others were also trying to help, e.g. my brothers and friends but I did not let them and I said to then that they don't know how to help him and that only I could do this. 2. I had a dream that I wa following Hazrat Moulana (DB) around the UK as he was delivering various talks around the country and that I was also studying under him at the same time whilst he travelled around. 3. I had another dream about a famous Scholar in the UK. I dreamt that He was teaching (dars) in the dar ul uloom where he teaches. I dreamt that I was sitting infront of him and that he requested me to read and explain the book he was doing a dars of and I refused saying "How can I read anything in your presence" but he insisted and so I began reading the book. However, as soon as I started reading, the respected Scholar got up hastily and left the room and everyone followed him out. 1457 views Q. Dream 1295 views Q. My female friend has two kids. answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 57976 Country: Bangladesh Title: کیا امام ابن تیمیہ حق اسکالر تھے یا نہیں؟اور کیا عقیدہ اور توحید کے بارے میں ان کی کتاب مستند ہے یا نہیں؟ Question: کیا امام ابن تیمیہ حق اسکالر تھے یا نہیں؟اور کیا عقیدہ اور توحید کے بارے میں ان کی کتاب مستند ہے یا نہیں؟ Answer ID: 57976 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! Fatwa ID: 380-379/N=5/1436-U علامہ ابن تیمیہ رحمہ اللہ مجموعی طور پر ایک محقق عالم دین تھے، لیکن بعض اصولی وفروعی مسائل میں ان سے بڑی چوک ہوئی ہے، ان میں انھوں نے جمہور علمائے امت سے ہٹ کر شذوذ تفرد کی رائے اختیار کی ہے؛ اس لیے عوام کو اور غیرمحقق علمائے کرام کو ان کی کتابوں کا مطالعہ نہ کرنا چاہیے۔ د Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
